claim_support.claim: The device failed to flag a clinically significant ventricular tachycardia (VT) episode in real-time during validation and retrospective review confirmed the miss of a sustained VT event.
Although no adverse outcome occurred for this specific instance, the failure involves a safety-critical function (arrhythmia detection).
Under ISO 13485 Clause 7.2.3 (referenced in qmsr-820.10-b-regulatory-crossrefs) and FDA QMSR § 820.10(c), design controls must ensure the device meets its intended use without unacceptable risk.

The absence of a root cause analysis, deployment logs confirming isolation to this build, or an updated clinical risk assessment constitutes missing evidence required for proper CAPA initiation per MDR Article 83(1)-(2) and FDA reporting obligations under part 806 if criteria are met.
